property_summary: The version() function always returns '1.0.0' after any call to setL1BlockValues.
The version() function always returns '1.0.0' before any call to setL1BlockValues.
After setL1BlockValues, the stored number must equal the _number argument passed in the call.
After calling setL1BlockValues with arbitrary parameters, timestamp equals the _timestamp parameter passed.
After calling setL1BlockValues, timestamp is not necessarily zero after a non-zero _timestamp parameter.
After setL1BlockValues, basefee must equal the _basefee argument (modulo underflow but both are uint256 so addition is safe).
After calling setL1BlockValues, the stored basefee must equal the provided _basefee argument.
After a successful call to setL1BlockValues, the public state variable basefee equals the passed _basefee argument.
After calling setL1BlockValues, the value of basefee is exactly equal to the _basefee parameter provided.
After a call to setL1BlockValues, the hash state variable must equal the _hash parameter passed in.
After calling setL1BlockValues, state variable batcherHash must equal the _batcherHash argument passed.
After calling setL1BlockValues with a nonzero _batcherHash, the batcherHash state variable equals the argument.
After calling setL1BlockValues, the stored batcherHash must equal the input _batcherHash.
After calling setL1BlockValues, batcherHash equals the _batcherHash argument passed to the function.
State variable batcherHash only changes when the caller is the depositor account.
When setL1BlockValues is called by a non-depositor, the batcherHash state variable remains unchanged.
After setL1BlockValues reverts for a non-depositor caller, batcherHash stays its previous value.
When setL1BlockValues reverts due to onlyDepositor modifier, batcherHash equals its original value before the call.
Only the depositor account can change batcherHash.
After a call to setL1BlockValues with any arguments, the stored batcherHash equals the caller-provided _batcherHash.
batcherHash only changes when the caller is the depositor account
batcherHash is set to the provided _batcherHash when the caller is the depositor account.
When the caller is NOT the depositor account, batcherHash remains unchanged after calling setL1BlockValues.
After any call to setL1BlockValues, the state variable batcherHash must not remain its default zero value unless the call reverted or was never made.
After any call to setL1BlockValues, the value of l1FeeOverhead must equal the provided _l1FeeOverhead argument.
After setL1BlockValues, the value of l1FeeOverhead equals the _l1FeeOverhead parameter passed to the call.
After setL1BlockValues, l1FeeOverhead equals _l1FeeOverhead when msg.sender is DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT.
After calling setL1BlockValues, the stored l1FeeOverhead must equal the provided _l1FeeOverhead argument.
After calling setL1BlockValues from the depositor account, the stored l1FeeOverhead must be between 0 and type(uint256).max.
After setL1BlockValues, l1FeeOverhead is set to a value that cannot exceed the maximum of uint256
After calling setL1BlockValues, the state variable l1FeeScalar equals the last argument passed to the function.
After calling setL1BlockValues, the state variable l1FeeScalar equals _l1FeeScalar when msg.sender is DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT
After a call to setL1BlockValues, the state variable number equals the provided _number parameter.
